cues.en: Baudrillard was offered a job by French newspaper to cover the war.
cues.zh: Baudrillard 收到一家法国报纸的工作邀请，去报道这场战争。

cues.en: So of course he agreed on condition he not go to The Gulf because he wanted to cover it on CNN where it would really happen.
cues.zh: 所以他当然答应了，条件是不去海湾，因为他想在 CNN 上报道这场战争，那才是真正发生的地方。

cues.en: We won't know who won or lost anywhere else so he... To cover the war in the in the sense of hyper reality the way to cover it is sitting in one's flat in Paris on CNN.
cues.zh: 在其他任何地方我们都不知道谁赢谁输，所以他……要在超现实的意义上报道战争，报道方式就是坐在巴黎的公寓里看 CNN。

cues.zh: 他就是这样报道这场战争的。

cues.zh: 他的论点是这样的：他非常认真地看待海湾战争。

cues.zh: 意思是，你……这些都不是理论。它就发生在你身边，所以忘掉鲍德里亚吧。

cues.en: He also wrote a book called Forget Foucault where he talks about how it's the spectacle of the prison more than the prison that frightens us now. In other words, it's rap music with its I'm gonna kill you stuff that really scares you. You very seldom ever see a black person. We mostly stay away from them.
cues.zh: 他还写过一本书，叫《忘掉福柯》。书里他说，现在让我们害怕的，与其说是监狱，不如说是监狱的景象。换句话说，真正吓人的，是那些唱着“我要杀了你”之类歌词的说唱音乐。你们很少能见到黑人。我们大多都躲着他们。

cues.en: So don't see many of them. It's sort of like their music that scares us by,
cues.zh: 所以见不到多少这种东西。这有点像他们的音乐吓到我们那样，

cues.en: you know,
cues.zh: 也就是，

cues.en: giving us a projection of street life itself that that parades as real
cues.zh: 向我们展现了一种伪装成现实的街头生活投影，

cues.en: but actually it's more real than real. You know, I've been in Compton. They don't have a drive by every two minutes. It's just that's not true.
cues.zh: 但实际上它比现实还要“逼真”。我去过康普顿，那里并不是每两分钟就有一次驱车枪击，根本不是那样的。

cues.en: I mean, not that I could prove it
cues.zh: 我是说，我也证明不了这点，

cues.en: because we have these images of hyper reality.
cues.zh: 因为我们脑子里充斥着这些超现实的画面。

cues.en: Well, this calls for fatal strategies
cues.zh: 好吧，按鲍德里亚的说法，

cues.en: according to Baudrillard. We have to adopt fatal strategies here. Fatal strategies.
cues.zh: 这就需要采取“致命策略”。我们在这里必须采取致命策略。致命策略。

cues.en: Extremes.
cues.zh: 极端情况。

cues.en: We have to learn to live with complexity,
cues.zh: 我们必须学会与复杂性共存，

cues.en: uncertainty,
cues.zh: 不确定性，

cues.en: and a certain amount of vertigo. We just have to do that. We don't have any choice.
cues.zh: 以及一定程度的眩晕感。我们只能这样。别无选择。

cues.en: I mean, we only have the dinosaur choice. That's what kind of wander off into the ice caps and sort of fall away.
cues.zh: 我是说，我们只有恐龙式的选择。就是那种漫游到冰盖里然后逐渐消亡。

cues.en: We... And I and I also think that that we have to be
cues.zh: 我们……我还认为，我们必须

cues.en: wary
cues.zh: 警惕

cues.en: of the of the over
cues.zh: 对

cues.en: over quick reduction of complexity.
cues.zh: 对复杂性过于快速的简化。

cues.en: If some of this lecture seemed a little weird or to go a little too far, it's because I don't want to reduce quite all of this to slogans.
cues.zh: 如果这堂课有些地方显得有点奇怪或走得太远，那是因为我不想把这一切都简化成口号。

cues.en: On the other hand, don't want it to not be funny because part of the postmodern trajectory
cues.zh: 另一方面，也不能让它变得不好笑，因为后现代的发展轨迹本身

cues.en: itself is a rather humorous joke on the human race which labored for millennia
cues.zh: 就是一个相当滑稽的笑话，讽刺人类耗费数千年

cues.en: to reduce working hours in order to produce leisure
cues.zh: 缩短工时，为自己创造闲暇

cues.en: so we could enjoy this very leisure that then turns in a kind of vengeful
cues.zh: 这样我们就能享受这份闲暇。可它后来却变成一种报复性的

cues.en: act against us absorbing
cues.zh: 行为，把

cues.en: our leisure time which was to be our living time
cues.zh: 原本属于我们生活的闲暇时间

cues.en: into time now spent in the service of what can only be called this inhuman spectacle.
cues.zh: 变成如今只能称作这场非人景观的服务时间。

cues.en: Mean, it's a very bizarre and twisted fight in which post modernity has led us.
cues.zh: 后现代主义把我们带入了一场极其诡异而扭曲的斗争。

cues.en: So I would be wary of simple answers to this.
cues.zh: 所以对于这类问题，我会对过于简单的答案保持警惕。

cues.en: One way to follow it without... To follow some of these developments without reading Baudrillard is to follow cyberpunk
cues.zh: 想跟进这些发展，又不想去读鲍德里亚的话，一种方法是去关注赛博朋克

cues.en: artifacts.
cues.zh: 文化产物。

cues.en: Movies like Blade Runner and
cues.zh: 比如《银翼杀手》这类的电影，

cues.en: also places which you're likely to show up in anyway.
cues.zh: 还有那些你本来就很可能会去的地方。

cues.en: Look at the latest malls and how the the tracks are designed in them.
cues.zh: 去看看最新建的商场，看看里面的人流路线是如何设计的。

cues.en: You know, the little paths. I mean you can't walk just anywhere in a mall now, can you?
cues.zh: 你知道，那些小路。我的意思是，在商场里你总不能随便乱走吧？

cues.en: I mean, they're little pathways,
cues.zh: 我是说，它们是小通道，

cues.en: tracks.
cues.zh: 小径。

cues.en: Look at the... Go to Atlanta and see a hotel that
cues.zh: 看看那……去亚特兰大看看那家酒店，

cues.en: gleams like a glistening palace and all this. Well, before I get too carried away with all these phenomena which you can see around you every day,
cues.zh: 闪闪发光，像个璀璨的宫殿之类的。好了，在我被这些每天都能在周围看到的现象带得太远之前，

cues.en: you've got to remember that even in that hotel in Atlanta in the winter,
cues.zh: 你得记住，即使是在亚特兰大那家酒店里，冬天的时候，

cues.en: the poor still crawl in the postmodern cracks and sleep at night.
cues.zh: 穷人仍然会爬进后现代的缝隙里，在夜晚睡下。

cues.en: So I mean, it is not as though
cues.zh: 我的意思是，这并不是说

cues.en: that turning the world as it were hyper real
cues.zh: 把世界变得仿佛超现实

cues.en: has somehow
cues.zh: 就 somehow

cues.en: done anything other
cues.zh: 做了什么

cues.en: than make our situation more extreme
cues.zh: 让我们的处境变得更加极端

cues.en: vis a vis those people who have fallen as it were out of the loop altogether.
cues.zh: 相较于那些仿佛彻底脱离了圈子的人。

cues.en: There is in this country now
cues.zh: 如今这个国家

cues.en: the most
cues.zh: 对那些落水的人

cues.en: alarming lack of sympathy for those people who've fallen off the boat, if you know what I mean.
cues.zh: 缺乏同情，到了令人担忧的地步，你懂我的意思吧。

cues.en: People who've somehow slipped off the track.
cues.zh: 那些不知怎么就偏离了轨道的人。

cues.en: I mean, I'm not sure they want a lot of sympathy but if they did there'd be an alarming short supply of it.
cues.zh: 我是说，我不确定他们是否需要很多同情，但如果他们需要，那同情心恐怕少得令人担忧。

cues.en: And I think part of that is because they add still further to the complexity.
cues.zh: 我觉得部分原因在于，它们进一步增加了复杂性。

cues.en: When I've talked about the postmodern in the way Baudrillard does as a trajectory,
cues.zh: 当我像鲍德里亚那样，将后现代视为一种演进轨迹时，

cues.en: I see it as an emergent aspect of our culture.
cues.zh: 我把它看作我们文化中正在显现的一个面向。

cues.en: Our culture is still dominantly
cues.zh: 我们的文化目前依然主要

cues.en: modernist,
cues.zh: 是现代主义的、

cues.en: rationalized,
cues.zh: 理性化的、

cues.en: capitalist, and so on.
cues.zh: 资本主义的，等等。

cues.en: And to even make things more complex,
cues.zh: 更复杂的是，

cues.en: thirdly, there are residual elements in our culture left over from earlier periods. For example, patriarchy
cues.zh: 第三，我们的文化中还残留着早期阶段遗留的元素。比如父权制，

cues.en: left over from a past as ancient perhaps as the species.
cues.zh: 它遗留自一段可能与人类物种本身一样古老的过去。

cues.en: Well,
cues.zh: 那么，

cues.en: I don't know how much further we can go down this road but in any case
cues.zh: 我不知道这条路我们还能走多远，但无论如何

cues.en: the road according to Baudrillard
cues.zh: 按照鲍德里亚的说法，这条路

cues.en: is an endless set
cues.zh: 是一个无尽的集合

cues.en: of what will it be fatal strategies
cues.zh: 由“会怎样”的致命策略构成

cues.en: to use his new title.
cues.zh: 用他的新标题来说。

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 而

cues.en: all we can do is wait and see what will happen.
cues.zh: 我们能做的只是等着看会发生什么。

cues.en: If nothing does
cues.zh: 如果什么都没发生

cues.en: in the sense of the real,
cues.zh: 在真实的意义上，

cues.en: Baudrillard will have a kind of confirmation.
cues.zh: 鲍德里亚就会得到某种证实。

cues.en: It's my hope that he will be disconfirmed
cues.zh: 我希望他会被证伪

cues.en: on the simple grounds that wherever we find power,
cues.zh: 理由很简单：无论我们在哪里发现权力，

cues.en: even the power of the hyper real,
cues.zh: 哪怕是超真实的权力，

cues.en: we found we find counter power.
cues.zh: 我们都会发现对抗性的权力。

cues.en: And where we see an image
cues.zh: 而当我们看到一幅图像，

cues.en: that reproduces us as inhuman,
cues.zh: 它把我们呈现得不近人情，

cues.en: occasionally we see an image
cues.zh: 偶尔，我们也会看到一幅图像，

cues.en: that somehow has the bizarre transcendent power to make us slightly more human again.
cues.zh: 它不知为何拥有一种奇异而超越性的力量，让我们重新找回一丝人性。

cues.en: But it's along that terrain I think that the battles and the struggles
cues.zh: 我认为，未来的战斗与挣扎

cues.en: the self will fight with itself
cues.zh: 会发生在这片领域之中：

cues.en: will be fought in the future.
cues.zh: 自我将与自我交锋。
